options.buttcraft.gas_quality.tooltip: Sets all gas options at once. Lower runs faster.
options.buttcraft.gas_resolution.tooltip: How sharp the gas looks. Lower is blurrier but faster.
options.buttcraft.gas_detail.tooltip: How smooth the gas looks. Lower is faster but can look grainy.
options.buttcraft.gas_shading.tooltip: How realistic the shadows inside the gas look. Lower is faster.
options.buttcraft.gas_puffs.tooltip: How many gas clouds can exist at once. Extras blend together. Lower is faster.
